description: Known violations grandfathered by scripts/check_claim_provenance.py. Entries are reported as WARN and do not fail the gate. Do not add new entries without a documented reason; remove entries once the underlying defect is fixed. 2026-08-26: the sidecar-missing entries are claim-bound artifacts produced before the .provenance.json protocol (docs/assurance/artifact_provenance_spec_v1.md, 2026-07-27). They are not backfilled: a sidecar records the producing run, and inventing one afterwards would be fabricated provenance. Each entry leaves this list when its artifact is regenerated under the rebenchmark protocol with a real sidecar. New claim-bound artifacts without a sidecar fail the gate.
